text:
Three pieces of fish fillet (white fish, possibly with skin) and bok choy on a square plate about 24 cm across.

- **Fish:** each piece is roughly 8×6 cm, so all three total about 180 g. At about 130 kcal per 100 g pan-fried, that is roughly 240 kcal.
- **Bok choy:** about 120 g. With some oil, about 50 kcal.
- **Total:** about 300 g and roughly 290 kcal, rounded to 300 g and 300 kcal.
